# Synthetic Worcester waste history

**SYNTHETIC. Not UMass data.** Generated by `uv run dcsim waste-gen` (engine/src/dcsim/synthetic.py) for 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-11.

- `consumption.csv`: MetaFoodX-style, per dish and 30-min window: portions put out, taken from the line, left.
- `waste_log.csv`: LeanPath-style weigh-ins: `expired` (past hold time), `close` (left in pans), `plate` (after eating; not affected by planning).
- `nights.csv`: one row per night. `waste_*` columns are pre-consumer (expired + close).
- `_ground_truth.json`: the generator's hidden noise; never shown in the UI.

Past nights reuse the real Nov 13–20 menu with the same weekday. Weights use menu serving sizes, or `data/worcester/portion_defaults.json` when a size isn't in ounces. Costs are estimates from the same file. 3 nights in the last two weeks followed the recommended plan (`smaller_batches`).
